what_to_detect: A spell or ability whose cost includes life: its cost half lists the life paid (costs.life), and the payer's life total drops by that amount, to 0 or less when that was all the life they had.
near_miss: A life cost larger than its payer's life total cannot be paid: the candidate fails the cost check and no cost half is written.

what_to_detect: A candidate whose cost_after_adjustment is strictly cheaper than its printed mana cost because of a static cost reduction.
near_miss: A candidate with no reduction in effect, whose adjusted cost equals the printed cost.

what_to_detect: A candidate under a generic cost reduction whose cost has no generic part, so its adjusted cost keeps every coloured symbol of the printed cost.
near_miss: A candidate under the same reduction whose generic part shrank.

what_to_detect: A candidate under a reduction by a coloured mana symbol the printed cost lacks, whose adjusted cost lost generic mana instead.
near_miss: A candidate with no reduction in effect.

what_to_detect: A candidate under a coloured reduction exceeding the cost's coloured component, whose adjusted cost lost the coloured symbol and generic mana too.
near_miss: A candidate under a smaller reduction that only removed the coloured symbol.

what_to_detect: A spell on the stack cast with an additional cost (kicker, buyback, an extra sacrifice) paid, whose mana value in the snapshot is the mana value of its printed mana cost, not the amount paid for it.
near_miss: A spell on the stack whose mana value differs from its printed mana cost's, which only an X chosen for it does (202.3e).

what_to_detect: A spell on the stack cast with an alternative cost (flashback, a 'rather than pay' cost, a free-cast permission) paid, whose mana value in the snapshot is the mana value of its printed mana cost, not the amount paid for it.
near_miss: A spell on the stack whose mana value differs from its printed mana cost's, which only an X chosen for it does (202.3e).

what_to_detect: A candidate cast for an alternative cost whose cost_after_adjustment still carries a static cost increase.
near_miss: A candidate cast for the alternative cost with no increase in effect.

what_to_detect: An ability whose 'if you do' effect depends on a cost paid as it resolves (Forge scripts it as the ability's cost, such as a sacrifice of its source): the cost half lists the payment (costs.sacrificed) and has a linked effect half holding the follow-up.
near_miss: The same kind of ability whose cost cannot be paid because the object it names is gone: its cost half lists no payment and no effect half follows.

what_to_detect: A spell candidate is affordable although its controller's mana sources cannot make a coloured symbol its mana cost requires, because an effect lets mana be spent as though it were mana of any type; the cast's cost half then lists mana of a colour the cost does not ask for (costs.mana_by_color against mana_cost).
near_miss: A candidate that is unaffordable because no source makes the colour its mana cost requires.
